content: Binata Molimbana Minaaka i Nuncana Tawo

Kasiimpo kukamata uka sambaa Binata Masega atiumba minaaka i nuncana tawo. Incia akotandu sapulu angu tee akobhaa pitu angu. I manga tanduna dhaangia sapulu angu mahakota, tee i manga bhaana atoburiaka manga saro mohinana Aulataʼala.

Binata Masega ikamataku sumai o bhanguna mboomo harimau mokotanda-tanda, maka o aena mboomo aena beruang tee o ngangana mboomo ngangana singa. Naga sumai adhawuaka to Binata Masega sumai o kakaana, kauncuramakana, tee kakuasana momaoge.
Sala saangu bhaana minaaka i pitu angua bhaana Binata Masega sumai mboomo dhaangia tee kambela imateaka, maka o kambela imateaka sumai auntomo. Saangua dunia amente tee aose Binata Masega sumai.

Manga incia asomba naga sumai, roonamo incia padhamo adhawuaka kuasana i Binata Masega sumai. Kasiimpo manga incia asomba uka Binata Masega incia sumai tee aabha, "Incema mopokanana tee Binata Masega incia sii? Incema buaka momembalina moewangia?"
Binata Masega sumai adhawuakea muncu to asomboaka karona tee ahina Aulataʼala tee incia atarima kuasa to apewaua kangengena pata pulu rua mbula.
Sabutuna incia abungkale muncuna tee ahina sarona Aulataʼala tee tampa mbooresana tee bhari-bharia mia momboorena i sorogaa.
Binata Masega sumai adhawuakea uka kuasa to abhali manga mia mosaalihi tee apekatalo manga incia, tee adhawuakea uka haku to aparinta bhari-bharia pogau, kaomu, suku, tee lipu.

Bhari-bharia mia i dunia bheasombaia, siitumo manga mia inda motoburina sarona minaaka i wakutuuna dunia atopadhaangia i nuncana Bokuna Mia Modhadhina i Sorogaa; boku incia sii o pewauana Anana Dumba motosumbele.
Incema mokotalingana, incia tabeana aporango!

content.text: mia itantuaka to atopekamate tee hancu,

content: I nuncana giu incia sii bhari-bharia mia mosaalihi tabeana asabara tee akoʼiimani.
Binata Molimbana minaaka i Nuncana Tana
Kasiimpo iaku uka kukamata sambaa binata mosagaanana molimbana minaaka i nuncana tana. Binata incia sii akotandu rua angu mboomo tanduna anana dumba tee ande apogau o suarana mboomo sambaa naga.

I aroana binata mobhaa-bhaana, binata incia sii uka apakea o hakuna to aparinta mopadhana itarimana minaaka i Binata Masega mobhaa-bhaana sumai. Saangua dunia tee bhari-bharia momboorena i nuncana apakisaaia to asomba i Binata Masega mobhaa-bhaana mountona minaaka i kambelana imateaka sumai.
Incia uka apadhaangia manga tanda inda momentela. I aroana manga mia, binata i rua mbaana incia sii uka apasapo waa minaaka i laiana tee apasapoa i bhawona dunia.

Rampaakanamo incia apewau manga tanda inda momentela tee kuasa itarimana minaaka i Binata Masega sumai, binata i rua mbaana apasaladhala manga mia momboorena i bhawona dunia. Incia atumpu manga mia sumai to apakaro saangu patu barahala mokobhanguna mboomo Binata Masega mobhaa-bhaana momambelana minaaka i hancu, maka dhaangiapo adhadhi.
Binata i rua mbaana sii amembali adhawuakea inyawa to patuna Binata Masega mobhaa-bhaana sumai, sabutuna o patu sumai amembali apogau tee apekamate bhari-bharia mia inda mosombaia.

Bhari-bharia mia, malape kaogesa atawa o mia maidhiidhi, morangkaeana atawa momisikinina, malape o bhatua atawa o maradhika, apakisaaia binata sumai to atarima tanda i lima kaanana atawa i bhawona rouna manga incia.
Inda samia uka momembalina mopoali poasona, maka tabeana manga incia mopakena tanda incia sumai, siitumo sarona Binata Masega incia sumai atawa o nomoro mosusuakana sarona.

I nuncana giu incia sii tabeana afaraluu hikimati. Mia moʼaarifu tabeana agagari maʼanana nomorona Binata Masega sumai, roonamo nomoro sumai asusuaka sarona samia maanusia. Nomoro sumai satotuuna 666.
